families.name: Winding Machines
families.summary: Air-coil, armature and stator winding across brushed, brushless and universal motors. Servo-driven wire placement, programmable tension, and multi-station configurations for higher throughput.

families.name: Rotor & Armature Equipment
families.summary: The complete armature route: slot insulation and wedge insertion, hook-type winding, commutator slot cutting and assembly, shaft embossing, welding and fusing, turning, balancing, varnish bake and final test.

families.name: Brushless Motor Equipment
families.summary: Dedicated BLDC stator preparation — horizontal and vertical slot insulation paper insertion, wedge insertion, and stator fusing. The equipment behind e-mobility, drone and cooling-fan motor programmes.

families.name: Modular Production Lines
families.summary: Standard machine modules linked into a running line — bobbin production, cooling-fan motor assembly, and configurable winding cells. Capacity is added by adding modules, not by replacing the line.

families.name: Custom Production Equipment
families.summary: Purpose-built automation where a catalogue machine does not fit: automatic feeding systems, turntable assembly cells and vibration-feed assembly equipment, designed around the part.

families.name: Robotic Production Lines
families.summary: SCARA and six-axis integration for handling, loading and inter-station transfer — used where cycle time or part geometry rules out fixed automation.

families.name: Stator Equipment
families.summary: Stator slot insulation paper insertion and varnish bake, for brushed and universal motor stators.

families.name: Semiconductor Process Equipment
families.summary: Sealing and testing process equipment built for semiconductor packaging — the same motion, vision and control platform applied outside motor production.

turnkey.title: One supplier, from bare wire to a tested motor.
turnkey.lede: Most equipment vendors cover a slice of the process and leave you to integrate the rest. We build every stage — winding, insulation, insertion, fusing, turning, balancing, varnish and test — and we plan the plant itself, not only the machines in it. That is what fifty listed manufacturers worldwide brought us in to do.
points: Plant planned from zero: line layout, workstation count, conveying method and footprint
Catalogue modules wherever they fit, purpose-built equipment where they do not
Barcode and laser marking for unit-level traceability across the line
Production data collected centrally, with a floor board showing line state live
Remote monitoring on any PLC-equipped machine — faults diagnosed over the internet
